resources.string: Remove HyperOS\'s restrictions on FCM connection-related broadcasts. System power consumption may increase when this module is enabled.

Only apps with detectable Firebase Messaging / legacy GCM message-entry components are shown by default. Checked apps may be woken / auto-started when a push arrives. Detection is heuristic, so you can show all apps for manual overrides.
